full_judgment: 7. The learned Advocate goes on to submit that the sanction so required under section 32 of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2004 has not been accorded before initiating the proceeding against the accused-petitioner mid in absence of, that very sanction the entire proceeding has been vitiated tilt which further continuation of the proceeding amounts to the abuse of the process the Court which is liable to be quashed. The learned advocate finally submits that though the informant in the FIR stated to investigate in to allegation but facts remains very investigation was held by an Assistant Director, Anti-Corruption Commission through in the charge sheet there is nothing to show when that very FIR was Forwarded to him (Assistant Director, Anti-Corruption Commission) for conducting such investigation whereas in rule 4 of Anti-Corruption Commission Rule 2007 it has been stipulated that upon registering the allegation the respective police station has to refer the case to the office of the Anti-Corruption Commission within 2 days so, the entire investigation as well the limitation of the proceeding against the petitioner is totally illegal and therefore, the same cannot be continued against the accused-petitioner.
